description: This file defines the 'GroupedIterator' class used for iterating over grouped, presorted rows in Spark SQL execution, including methods for grouping, iteration, and comparison of rows based on grouping expressions.

classes.name: GroupedIterator
classes.description: A class for iterating over presorted rows, chunking by grouping expressions, and lazily constructing group iterators.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Factory method to create a GroupedIterator instance if input has elements, otherwise returns an empty iterator.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if there is a next group iterator available or can be fetched.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the current group key and its associated iterator, then resets the current iterator.

methods.name: fetchNextGroupIterator
methods.description: Fetches the next group of rows, preparing an iterator for that group.

methods.name: createGroupValuesIterator
methods.description: Creates an iterator over the rows in the current group.

methods.name: fetchNextRowInGroup
methods.description: Fetches the next row within the current group, peeking ahead to determine group boundaries.
